description: Header file defining memory management functions and related documentation for bbfdm context, including initialization, allocation, reallocation, duplication, string formatting, and cleanup.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_mem
methods.description: Initializes the memory management list for the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_mem
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory in the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbfdm_malloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory and tracks it in the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbfdm_calloc
methods.description: Allocates and zero-initializes a block of memory in the context.

methods.name: bbfdm_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates a previously allocated memory block to a new size.

methods.name: bbfdm_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string and tracks it in the context.

methods.name: bbfdm_asprintf
methods.description: Formats a string and allocates memory for it in the context.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_mem_bloc
methods.description: Frees a specific memory block from the context's list.
